answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making each identity pay a real upfront cost. Every new agent must lock a refundable stake of ten copper and pass hardware attestation proving it runs on genuine silicon. Each forged identity then becomes a costly vertex the attacker funds with real capital they cannot recover. This raises the marginal cost of every fake node from a free private-key click to actual money, so flooding the network with puppets stops being profitable. Commerce, from mine to wharf, flows only through identities that paid to exist.
